answer_1.quote: Recent advances in simultaneous machine translation (SIMULMT) hold the promise of breaking language barriers by democratizing simultaneous interpretation, a demanding form of real-time translation which currently requires trained human experts.
answer_1.outputs: translated text outputs in real time for question answering

answer_2.quote: We compute BLEU, COMET, and BertScore. We use Differentiable Average Lagging as a latency metric for SIMULMT.

answer_4.quote: We obtain reference translations for the Polish questions into English by asking human translators to post-edit full-input MT, providing randomly ordered Google Translate (GT), SMT and Transformer-big outputs (Section 4.2), to avoid biasing references toward a single MT system.
answer_4.guideline: avoid biasing references toward a single MT system by using randomly ordered outputs from multiple systems for post-editing
